candidates.name: C8 depth-trim probe
candidates.role: C7 + cathode R 1.5 um: tests whether trimming 4C CC depth (via higher cathode polarization) buys plating margin; also DFN cross-check of C7's 4C in the same round

llm_reason: R6 C7: anode min +0.0082 V (SPMe), T 318.79, 82% CC - pass with improved margin. Two remaining robustness questions: (1) does DFN (full gradient resolution) agree with SPMe at 4C? (2) can CC-depth trimming add margin cheaply? C8 probes (2); C7-DFN answers (1). Endorsement follows from whichever combination gives margin with best acceptance.
